articleTitle: Road Network Modeling and Simulation Based on Sysml Meta-Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: With the advancement of urban construction, the design process of urban road network becomes more and more complex. The huge road data and complex road planning greatly increase the difficulty of road network design. The research proposes a road network design idea based on the Systems Modeling Language (SysML) meta-model. In the early stage of road network design, this method can enhance the plane expression ability of the model, and rich road attribute data can be added to the model to enhance the flexibility of road network data. In the experiment, we constructed the corresponding meta-model and built the road network model according to the relevant knowledge of the road network, studied the model batch data import technology and provided road and traffic data for the road network model through the public simulation data set, combined with the addressing algorithm and BPR algorithm to develop a simulation method for path planning. Finally, through a simulation experiment, successfully shows the shortest distance and shortest time route diagram from the specified starting point to the specified end point, which verifies the feasibility of the method proposed in this paper. Road network design based on SysML meta-model can improve the efficiency of basic road network modeling and reduce modeling costs to a certain extent. This research provides an important reference for the follow-up model-based systems engineering research on road network modeling.

articleTitle: Improved NSGA-II to Solve Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem Considering Random Worker Resignations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: As an important production factor in flexible job, human resource dynamic events have an important impact on job scheduling plan. Therefore, this paper studies the flexible job scheduling problem considering the random resignation of workers. A model is established with the maximum completion time and deviation as the optimization objectives, and an improved NSGA-II algorithm is proposed based on the characteristics of the problem. First, an initialization method based on heuristic rules is designed to improve the quality of population initialization; an individual selection scheme based on simulated annealing algorithm is proposed to increase the selection probability of non-excellent individuals and ensure population diversity; an adaptive crossover operator and mutation operator are designed; finally, the tabu search operator is introduced to reduce the number of invalid searches, thereby increasing the overall search scope and capability of the algorithm. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm are verified by comparing the experimental results.

articleTitle: Interference Analysis of Different Modulation Signals to Communication Receiver
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In order to solve the interference problem of communication receiver in complex electromagnetic environments, this paper constructs a communication receiver performance model and analyzes the transfer function. Taking the frequency modulation communication receiver as an example, the interference characteristics of amplitude shift keying and frequency shift keying on communication receiver are obtained through simulation calculation, and the different interference effects are compared and analyzed. This study provides a reference for the anti- interference research of communication receiver in complex electromagnetic environments.

articleTitle: Study on the Matching Relationship Between Compressed Air Energy Storage Chambers and Capacity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In order to explore the CAES chamber and energy storage capacity matching relationship research, this paper to three-stage turbine release of CAES system as the object of study, the construction of the corresponding thermodynamic model, the study of CAES capacity and energy storage physical space volume, pressure capacity, high-pressure air heating temperature of the heat source, the efficiency of the turbine and the heat exchanger between the relationship between the results show that: Under the condition of certain storage pressure, as heat source temperature increases, the required storage chamber volume decreases gradually and the influence is weaker and weaker; the change of turbine efficiency is more significant than the change of heat exchanger efficiency on the output power; when the maximum pressure of the storage chamber is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$7.2\text{MPa}$</tex>, the heat exchanger efficiency is 0.8, the temperature of the heat source is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$300^\circ \mathrm{C}$</tex>, and the length of energy release is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\mathrm{h}$</tex>, increasing of the compressed air power generation power makes the storage chamber volume increase and the compressed air power generation power increase. When the maximum pressure of air power generation is 7. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\text{MPa}$</tex>, efficiency of heat exchanger is 0.8, the temperature of heat source is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$300^\circ \mathrm{C}$</tex> and the length of energy release is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\mathrm{h}$</tex>, the increase of compressed air power generating power increases the volume of chamber linearly, and the volume of air storage chamber corresponds to 0.21 million cubic meters for 1MW power generation.

articleTitle: Development and Application of New Lead Wire Fixing Clamps for 10kV Live Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Electric energy is a vital resource for national economic growth and societal advancement. To maintain continuous power supply, power companies have developed live work techniques to repair lines and equipment without outages. Among these, live connection is a prominent operation, integrating non-energized components with live lines. This article analyzes the process and time efficiency of live connections, outlining five key steps. Based on insights into time consumption, strategic improvements are proposed to enhance overall performance.

articleTitle: Study on Thermodynamic Characteristics of High Elastic Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: For the problem of high elastic coupling failure caused by high local temperature due to the viscoelastic hysteresis loss of rubber element in the process of loading, a thermodynamic simulation model of high elastic coupling is theoretically established based on the finite element method and the nodal equivalence algorithm, and a systematic analysis is carried out to analyze the temperature field, thermal stresses, and thermal modes of high elastic coupling. The study shows that the calculated results of the model are in good agreement with the predicted results. Further research shows that the thermal stress field has little effect on the mode of the high elastic coupling compared with the temperature field. Therefore, the influence of thermal stress can be ignored when analyzing the vibration mode of the high elastic coupling.

articleTitle: A Cryo-CMOS Wideband Sub-1-dB NF Low Noise Amplifier for Quantum Computing Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: This paper presents a wideband Low-Noise Amplifier (LNA) implemented in 55-nm CMOS process for cryogenic applications. At the cryogenic temperatures down to 4 K, the proposed Low-Noise Amplifier (LNA) with a noise cancellation technique achieves noise figure (NF) below 1 dB in the frequency range from 70 MHz to 1.1 GHz and maximum 36.7 dB gain with a 3dB bandwidth of 1.19 GHz. Power consumption is 34 mW from a 1.2 V power supply. In summary, the power consumption and bandwidth of the full chip lead to a P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">qubit</inf> = 75 µW/qubit for 450 qubit channels.

articleTitle: Research on Cooling Capacity Energy Efficiency Testing Methods and Uncertainty Assessment of Express Cold Chain Vehicle-Mounted Refrigeration Units
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of balance ratio drift during long-term use of balanced environment room calorimeter, this article establishes a measurement model based on the basic principles of thermodynamics and the installation method of the vehicle-mounted refrigeration unit, and verifies the correctness of the measurement model by conducting a onemonth test on an integrated refrigeration unit with a cooling capacity range of (2000∼7000) W. The results show that the absolute value of the balance ratio results in the cooling capacity measurement range of 2000W∼7000W is less than 2%, and the balance ratio in the range of 4500W∼7000W is less than 1%, which is consistent with the national standard balance ratio of 4% and the international standard balance ratio of 5%. In comparison, the method described here significantly reduces the room calorimeter equilibrium ratio measurements. Finally, a measurement model is selected, and uncertainty analysis is performed on it.

articleTitle: Study on Optimization of Recycled Cooling Water Reagents by Response Surface Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Due to the scarcity of water resources, using reclaimed water as a source of circulating cooling water in thermal power plants is a popular research topic. The composite formulation obtained by response surface optimization was 17 mg/L Hydrolyzed poly-maleic Anhydride (HPMA) + 40 mg/L Tetradecyl dimethyl benzyl ammonium chloride (1427) + 90 mg/L Sodium gluconate + 11 mg/L zinc sulfate, and the three functions of scale inhibition, biocide and corrosion inhibition of the composite water treatment agent were evaluated by using static scale inhibition, biocide energy efficiency evaluation and weight loss method. The results showed that the corrosion inhibition rate of the composite water treatment agent on Q235 carbon steel could reach 91. 89%. It is a multifunctional, environmentally friendly water treatment agent for reclaimed water treatment.

articleTitle: Optimizing Photovoltaic Power Generation: A Fuzzy Control-Perturbation Observation Approach for Maximum Power Point Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: This study examines the performance characteristics of photovoltaic cells and the mechanisms behind controlling the maximum power point tracking. A mathematical model is developed to precisely represent the power generated by a solar cell. Additionally, a new control strategy is introduced that utilizes fuzzy control and perturbation observation techniques. The proposed strategy is evaluated against standard perturbation observation and fuzzy control methods using MATLAB/Simulink simulations. The results indicate exceptional performance, characterized by increased tracking speed, improved tracking accuracy, and enhanced resistance to interference. This strategy has great potential for enhancing the efficiency of electricity generation.

articleTitle: Tower Line Condition Assessment Based on Improved Fuzzy Integrated Judgment Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Transmission tower line condition assessment plays an important role in transmission line maintenance and repair. This paper adopts the improved fuzzy comprehensive judgment method to evaluate the tower line status, constructs a transmission tower line evaluation index system consisting of three primary indicators and nine secondary indicators, calculates the evaluation index weights through the improved three-scale hierarchical analysis method, develops a five-level status comment level, and uses fuzzy synthesis to obtain the transmission tower line status evaluation results. After the example verification, the tower line status evaluation method based on the improved fuzzy synthesis evaluation method is more consistent with the actual situation than the traditional fuzzy synthesis evaluation method, and can provide relevant reference basis for line maintenance and repair.

articleTitle: Rapid Identification of Oil Sands Based on GF-2 Remote Sensing Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: To explore the professional applications of China's high-resolution Earth observation satellite project, this research studies the theoretical basis of using remote sensing technology to identify oil sands based on the spectral response mechanism, combined with the theoretical spectral response of oil sand components and surface anomalies caused by hydrocarbon micro-seepage. Field samples were collected, indoor hyperspectral testing and oil content data were obtained. The correlation between the spectral features of oil sands and oil content was analyzed, using the correlation between oil sand spectral reflectance and oil content as an indicator to screen for oil sand sensitive bands in GF-2 data. Corresponding oil sand remote sensing anomaly identification indices were constructed and applied to GF -2 imagery. The research results can rapidly identify oil sand mineralization zones and predict prospective areas from GF -2 remote sensing imagery, providing a reference for the application of remote sensing technology in oil sand resource research and the professional applications of China's high-resolution Earth observation satellite project.

Author Keywords: Oil sands identification index of GF-2 image

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Analysis of Generator Rotor Winding Impedance When Testing Turn-to-Turn Faults
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Electromagnetic analysis has been carried out and recommendations given for using a method to test turn-to-turn faults in generator rotor winding through impedance measurement. For a rotor inside a stator, electromagnetic properties of the materials used were taken into account; frequency and value of supply voltage; slot wedging conditions; position of short-circuit turns in rotor slots. The criterion for the maximum sensitivity of the method for monitoring turn-to-turn faults at power frequency when using the reactance parameters of the rotor winding was determined.

articleTitle: A Design of Bidirectional Reversible Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Filtration is the primary method of pollution control, and as hydraulic technology has advanced, more stringent standards for polluting control have been established. In order to determine the overall design of the two-way reversible filter, this paper studies the oil fluid filter. Two sliding single-way valves that were designed by the author are used to create a bridge circuit, which allows the fluid to flow in both positive and reverse directions in the same direction. The oil path structure is then used to provide double-directional filtration, failure early warning, and protection of oil path functions. The filter core design, which replaces and cleans the filter layer through the detachable end cover, is the main attraction. It is designed like a round table. Finally, the comparison of the new filter core and the traditional filter core highlighted the advantages of the circular filter core with strong flow capacity, large efficient filter area and high filtration accuracy, and noted that it is insufficient to provide requirements for further improvement.

articleTitle: Control Multiplexing and Switching Methods for Bi-Directional EV Chargers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) using bi-directional electric vehicle (EV) chargers is mostly using the grid-side inverter to regulate a stable DC bus voltage, while the car-side DCDC converter controls the bi-directional current to/from the car battery pack. However, to fully utilize its bi-directional power capability to be grid-friendly, the bi-directional charger can also be used as a grid-forming inverter to provide inertia support to the grid. The different modes of the EV chargers require different controls, which need to switch between each other. Therefore, this paper introduces a unified control algorithm architecture that shares most control modules between two sets of algorithms: one for normal operation of bi-directional charging and the other for grid-forming operation. The proposed control architecture enables seamless online mode switching without requiring power off or a restart of the main control circuit. Finally, the validity of the proposed method has been verified via simulations.

articleTitle: Study on the Added Mass, Damping and Stiffness for Fluid-Induced Vibration System of NASA Rotor 37 Blade
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The unidirectional and bidirectional Fluid-Structure Interaction (FSI) numerical models of NASA Rotor 37 blade for 1.5 subsonic compressor was established in present work to investigate the aerodynamic and vibration characteristics. Thus, the aerodynamic performance, pressure coefficient and unsteady aerodynamic excitation of the FSI system were obtained, firstly. Then, the blade FSI vibration characteristics in time domain and frequency domain that excited by unsteady aerodynamic was further studied. Finally, the calculated model of added mass, damping and stiffness for the blade FSI system are also given. The results shown that: aerodynamic performance and pressure coefficient ratio is significantly affected by the radial deformation of blade FSI vibration. The periodic aerodynamic excitation force may increase due to the effect of blade FSI vibration, and the disturbance frequency of FSI system was mainly consisted of vibration frequency (492Hz) and stator-rotor interaction frequency (8604Hz). Then, the fluid force of blade FSI system can transform into added mass, damping and stiffness, where the added stiffness has greater effect on the frequency of NASA Rotor 37 blade than the added mass, whereas the added damping result in a decreasing time history displacement.

articleTitle: Harmonic Vibration Filtering Technology of Frequency Conversion Motor on Escalator Based on Improved Cepstrum Editing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the signal is vulnerable to high order harmonic interference caused by frequency converter in the vibration monitoring of frequency conversion motor on escalator, a harmonic vibration filtering method based on SFLP-CE (Selected Frequency Linear Predicated Citrum Editing) is proposed First of all, the full band spectrum is obtained by Fourier transform of the time domain signal, and the full band spectrum is divided into the low frequency part and the high frequency part; Then, the example and phase of the low request part remains unchanged, and set the target spectral line to achieve the cepstrum editing of the high request part using the linear prediction method, and the edited high request logistic spectrum is obtained Finally, the filtered time domain signal is reconstructed by combining low frequency spectrum, high frequency spectrum, and phase information Verified by the measured vibration data of frequency conversion motor on escalator, the result shows that the harmonic interference filtering method based on SFLP-CE has strong harmonic interference filtering ability than conventional cepstrum editing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Operation and Maintenance Technology Based on Power Distribution Edge Gateway
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The power distribution edge gateway plays a very important role in the field of distributed energy. How to ensure the functional stability of the power distribution edge gateway and how to extend the business functions based on the edge gateway are the focus of current research. In this paper, a special plug-and-play communication platform is introduced to realize the real-time communication with the existing power distribution edge gateway. Then the remote and local automatic test system deployed on the communication platform is introduced, which is used to automatically test the accuracy of the interaction between the power distribution edge gateway and the edge cluster. Finally, the system architecture and application of the integrated intelligent monitoring system for power distribution substation based on the power distribution edge gateway are introduced.

Author Keywords: remote and local automatic test system
integrated intelligent monitoring system for distribution substation

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Navigation System Based on Strapdown Inertial Component/Odometer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Aiming at the difficult problems of the accuracy of vehicle strapdown inertial navigation/odometer combination navigation over time and the divergence of mileage errors, this paper analyzes how to quickly calibrate the odometer scale factor and inertial component installation error angle and compensation technology. A Kalman filtering technology is proposed for odometer combination navigation, odometer scale coefficient, and inertial system installation error calibration in complex road environments, which meets the mutual correction of inertial component navigation and odometer tight combination, improves the accuracy of system positioning, attitude, and attitude update rate. The simulation results show that using tight combination can effectively estimate and correct position and attitude errors. The experimental results verify that the combined navigation method is superior to the traditional dead reckoning loose combination method and can effectively achieve the accuracy of the inertial navigation system.

articleTitle: Study on the Coordination of the Components Inside SPD Specific Disconnector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Due to the limitations in the applicability and reliability of conventional backup protective devices for Surge Protective Devices (SPDs), it is crucial to study the coordination of the specific protective devices that are developing very quickly with SPDs. This paper explores the SPD Specific Disconnector (SSD) coordination mechanism to solve the problem of mis-operation under lightning impulse. Firstly, the background significance of backup protection is introduced. Then it analyzes the characteristics and applicability of fuses and circuit breakers as traditional backup protective devices. Next, the working principle of SSDs and the characteristics of mis-operation and refuse operation are examined. To address the issue of mis-operation of SSDs, an experimental analysis of the cooperation mechanism between the electromagnetic coil and GDT is conducted. The results of this study provide an efficient and reliable improvement program for SSDs.

articleTitle: Forecast and Analysis of Passenger Flow of Airport Comprehensive Transportation Hub
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The landside transportation system is a critical component of the comprehensive transportation hub at airports. Accurate passenger flow forecasting not only ensures the efficient operation of the airport but also provides a crucial basis for subsequent design efforts. This paper, focusing on the two key influencing factors of tourist numbers in Qinghai Province and the GDP of Xining City, employs time series analysis, linear regression forecasting, Bobugamen formula, trend extrapolation, and econometric models to conduct a scientific prediction of the passenger throughput at Caojiapu Airport for the upcoming years. The results offer a scientific foundation and design approach for the development and construction of similar airports and integrated transportation hubs.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Laver Harvesting Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The equipment used for Chinese laver collection is primarily foam collection rafts, which pose safety hazards and have low collection efficiency, leading to high levels of pollution emissions. These issues are hindering the growth and development of the Chinese laver culture industry. This study presents a novel laver harvesting equipment comprising of a spiral roller harvester, High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) catamaran, mesh frame, hydraulic power system, and other components. In a comparative test of offshore production, the new laver harvesting equipment demonstrated an increase in harvesting efficiency when compared to the foam raft. Specifically, the harvesting efficiency of the foam raft was increased by 3.86%, 6.31%, and 6.06% respectively, resulting in a significant difference (P < 0.05). The average harvesting efficiency of the new equipment was measured at 39.51 kg/min, 40.42 kg/min, and 39.91 kg/min. It shows that the device has reasonable structure design, reasonable operation parameter setting, high harvesting efficiency, good safety and stability, which can meet the needs of laver harvesting operation and has the value of popularization and application.

articleTitle: A New Computer Performance Evaluation Model of Extended Cloud Based on Optimal Cloud Entropy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new computer performance evaluation model based on the extension cloud model. This approach eliminates the misjudgment of performance levels caused by the uncertainty of the evaluation process. The optimal cloud entropy adaptive method is introduced into the model to further adjust the clarity and fuzziness of the grade boundary. For nonlinear decision-making models in optimal cloud entropy computation methods, we propose the Improved Archimedean Optimization Algorithm (IAOA). IAOA uses random Gaussian variation strategy to guide the population to search the optimal solution region and enhance the global search ability. Finally, the experimental results demonstrate that this method effectively evaluates computer performance, and the evaluation results align with the actual situation.

articleTitle: Study on Skin Cancer Classification Based on Image Fractal Dimension
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Skin disease is one of the common diseases in human beings. A large proportion of skin diseases eventually develop into skin cancer because of lacking of timely detection and corresponding early treatment. One of the most deadly cancers is malignant melanoma, which kills many people every year. Fractal dimensions can be used to describe the properties of graphic surface roughness. For dermoscopic lesion images, fractal dimension is widely used to study the changes of internal structure of biological tissues. In this study, we used data set of ISIC 2016 to obtain a larger sample of data, excluding lots of hair, skin ulceration et al., the number of remaining pictures is 852, including 676 pictures of benign nevus and 176 pictures of melanoma. In the case of a relatively big sample, the fractal dimension of melanoma is still higher than that of benign nevus, even if the equipment, magnification, exposure time and other conditions are different. At the same time, in order to avoid the influence of the lesion area, we tried to unify the lesion area, and found that the fractal dimension of melanoma and benign nevus are still statistically different, and the p value is lower, which verified that the method of unifying the lesion area is effective. Specifically, changes in fractal dimension may reflect the pathological metabolic changes of melanoma.

articleTitle: Research on E-Waste Risk Assessment through the Construction of a Cloud Platform in the Context of a Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In the realm of big data, the volume of research data in universities is expanding rapidly. However, the lack of data collaboration results in data isolation, hindering the realization of their potential value. This study aims to enhance data interoperability and promote data reuse by developing a comprehensive metadata scheme, which facilitates standardized descriptions of scientific data metadata throughout the entire process, from data generation to citation. Additionally, by delineating the data governance process encompassing data collection, processing and handling, archival and management, as well as data utilization and sharing, a data management cloud platform is established based on data reuse patterns. This platform incorporates features for data retrieval, storage and management, and data monitoring, ensuring the seamless continuity of research management efforts.

articleTitle: Predictive Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Model Based on Reference Voltage Vector Position
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Model predictive torque control is a method of solving a mathematical model of a motor system iteratively in order to optimize the control action in each control cycle. The method demonstrates control performance in the field of PMSM control with high efficiency, fast response and strong disturbance resistance. Model-predictive torque control requires substituting seven fundamental voltage vectors for electromagnetic torque and stator magnetic chain prediction in each cycle, which requires a large amount of computational resources and time; conventional model-predictive control uses torque and chain hysteresis-loop control, where one fundamental voltage vector is applied in one cycle. However, this method has a problem that the phase current waveforms and electromagnetic torque waveforms have large pulsations within a cycle. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a model predictive voltage control strategy based on the torque chain without differential beat. The strategy calculates the position of the reference voltage for reference voltage vectors with different calculated values through coordinate transformation and sector identification, so as to narrow down the range of candidate reference voltage vectors. Simulation experimental results show that the proposed method has more efficient control performance in terms of practical performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Temperature Distribution in Microwave Heating Based on Finite Difference Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Microwave heating entails the interaction of multiple, interconnected physical fields. Traditional numerical methods cannot directly compute the temperature distribution of materials during microwave heating. This paper analyzes two calculation methods: the explicit Euler difference method and the Crank-Nicolson difference method. The performance of these two methods in simulating the temperature distribution of deionized water under microwave heating is compared. Through simulation experiments, it is demonstrated that both methods yield results within a high accuracy range. The explicit Euler difference method has slightly lower computational accuracy but is simple and fast, while the Crank-Nicolson difference method offers higher precision at the expense of greater computational complexity. Depending on specific requirements, the suitable method can be selected to simulate the microwave heating process, thereby supporting the application of this technology.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Hydrodynamic Response and Stability Performance of a Cable-Laying Vessel Under Various Mooring Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The submarine cable is critical for the electricity transmission for the offshore islands and wind farms, which requires professional construction vessels for safe and reliable operations. In this study, the dynamic responses and stability performances of the largest cable-laying vessel, Qifan No. 9, under various operating conditions were analyzed numerically. Effects of the number of mooring lines and their included angles on the vessel motions and tensions in the mooring lines were studied. Compared to the four-line plan, the eight-line plan caused an increase in the swaying motion, a decrease in the yawing motion and tensions in the mooring lines of the windward side, the change in the angle between the lines has minor effects on the stability of the vessel.

articleTitle: Numerical Study on Protective Wall Effects on Hydrogen Leakage and Combustion at a Hydrogen Refueling Station
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Hydrogen refueling stations are pivotal for the rapid development and commercialization of hydrogen energy. This study used the FLACS software to model hydrogen leakage and combustion at a hydrogen refueling station in China. The protective wall effects on hydrogen leakage and combustion were evaluated in this paper. The results show that the presence of protective walls can efficiently hinder the spread of hydrogen clouds, reduce the potential harm to humans and buildings, and significantly decrease the required safety distances for hydrogen leakage and combustion accidents. This study can provide reference and guidance for the safe design of hydrogen refueling stations.

articleTitle: Multi Node Parallel Feature Extraction and 3D Scene Construction for Wide Detection Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Remote sensing images are the true representation of various natural and human elements in the surface scene. Due to their good adaptability and wide detection range, they are widely used in the military field, and play an important role in fire reconnaissance, intrusion warning, flight guidance, landform mapping, etc. important role. For a remote sensing image, how to quickly and efficiently complete its feature evaluation has gradually become a hot research issue in recent years. This paper builds a set of visual parallel processing remote sensing image evaluation system. The system can support three analysis modes: pure terrain, pure scene, and scene plus terrain. The grid window is the basic unit, and multiple CPUs are used to perform parallel feature extraction and analysis on remote sensing images, and mirror and display the evaluated results in the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\mathrm{D}$</tex> scene. Remote sensing image data. Compared to traditional methods, software significantly improves computational efficiency and result availability.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy Microgrids Considering Demand Response and Hybrid Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-objective optimization hybrid game model considering demand response and shared energy storage. Firstly, the Iterative Selforganizing Data Analysis Techniques Algorithm clustering method is used to cluster wind and solar scenarios. At this stage, the distribution network acts as the leader, and a leader-follower game model is constructed with comprehensive scheduling cost, net load variance, and integrated vulnerability as the objective functions. Secondly, considering the demand response of multiple microgrids and shared energy storage as followers, a cooperative game model is formed under optimized electricity pricing, with operational cost and environmental protection cost as the objective functions. To address the model characteristics, an improved Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm is used to solve the leader model, while the follower model is solved using the CPLEX solver. The results demonstrate that the proposed model can effectively stabilize alliance relationships and reduce the operational costs of microgrids and distribution networks, the validity of the proposed method has been demonstrated through empirical validation.

articleTitle: Research on the Cooling Water Flow Model of Indirect Air Cooling Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In indirect air cooling unit, operating double circulating pump can't decrease efficiently the exhausted pressure of steam turbine. This problem was illustrated in detail. The “indirect air cooling cycle” and mathematical model for calculating circulating water flow for indirect air cooling. By this mathematical model, the calculating circulating water flow was only half of the designed value. The designing number of circulating pump and the initial investment of new power plant were reduced. And the auxilary power rate was reduced in the operating unit. Theoretical basis was supported for the optimizing designing and operating of indirect air cooling unit.

articleTitle: Research on Lightweight Wireless Charging System with Concentrated Winding Coils for Quadcopter Drones
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The utilization of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has seen exponential growth in recent years, spurring the need for efficient charging solutions for their batteries. This paper introduces a novel single-sided coupling mechanism, wherein the magnetic loop produced by the transmitter coil is oriented perpendicularly to the receiving coil. To enhance the transmission efficiency of the system and mitigate the impact of magnetic fields on the UAV and the equipment it carries, several measures are implemented. Initially, the receiving coil is affixed to the side of the UAV's frame, optimizing the coupling efficiency between the coils. Magnetic materials are incorporated into the coupling mechanism to minimize energy losses. Furthermore, after conducting finite element simulations and comparative analyses of four compensation structures, the Series-Series (S-S) compensation network topology is selected. This design not only satisfies the requirement for a lightweight receiver but also exhibits robustness against misalignment. A prototype of the UAV wireless power transmission system is constructed, and experimental tests are carried out. The results demonstrate that the system can effectively deliver 104W of charging power with a charging efficiency of 74.58%.

articleTitle: Research on Security Control Technology of Maintenance and Operation Process Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In order to resolve the risk such as entering live area by mistake, maloperation caused by equipment offline, lack of technical association for maintenance isolation, and closing of circuit breakers with temporary ground wires in the actual maintenance, a safety management and control scheme for the entire process of maintenance and operation based on IoT sensing technologies such as ultra wide band high-precision positioning and long-range radio communication is studied. Firstly, build a heterogeneous topology network based on the primary main wiring diagram of the substation and the spatial location modelling data of the substation, and automatically form a virtual electronic fence according to the maintenance needs, specify the scope of work, and lock the remote operation authority of all equipment within the scope of work, during the operation, realizes real-time positioning control of operators and temporary ground wires by the high-precision positioning network, real-time online smart keys and smart ground wires are realized through wireless networks to ensure real-time control of the operation process and real-time perception of ground wire status. Finally, the safety control of the entire process of maintenance and operation is realized.

articleTitle: Harmonics Feedforward Compensator to the Current Loop of the Virtual Synchronous Generator Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In modern power grids, virtual synchronous generator (VSG) as an emerging technology can face the problem of grid current distortion when connected to a distorted grid. In order to improve the quality of grid-connected current, this paper proposes a harmonic current suppression method for VSG based on current loop input feedforward. The method effectively enhances the harmonic current suppression capability of VSG through the current loop input feed-forward technique, and successfully realizes the closed-loop suppression of harmonic current. Specifically, in this paper, the grid-side current is firstly input into a first-order complex vector filter in order to obtain the fundamental component of the grid-side current without static error in the steady state. The harmonic sums of the grid-side currents are further extracted by the extraction method, and then these harmonic sums are fed forward to the inner-loop input of the VSG through the proportional resonant control link. This method not only realizes the closed-loop suppression of grid-side current harmonics, but also avoids the system stability problem that may be caused by the grid-side current fundamental component into the current inner loop. Finally, this paper verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method through simulation, and the results show that the method performs well in both harmonic suppression and system stability, providing reliable technical support for the application of VSGs in complex grid environments.

articleTitle: Analysis of Synchronous Unstable Vibration Faults in High Pressure Rotors of Siemens Ultra Supercritical Steam Turbine Units
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The synchronous unstable vibration problem commonly exists in the bearing no.1 of the high-pressure rotor of Siemens single support ultra supercritical 660MW/1000MW steam turbine. As a newly introduced and put into operation unit, many units are still in the initial and exploratory stage of researching the vibration of Siemens type million units. Due to its single support and floor mounted bearings being completely different from other types of million unit or conventional 300 and 600MW units, the understanding of its vibration mechanism is still unclear, and research on the vibration of this type of unit is still in the initial and exploratory stage. Through case analysis, it is found that the causes of vibration include dynamic and static rubbing of the ro-tor, as well as the high critical speed design of the high-pressure rotor.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Numerical Simulation of Flow Sound Field of Wind Turbine Tower Structure Under Different Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: This paper explores the flow sound field distribution characteristics of a wind turbine tower surface using the AR linear filtering method with a random load inlet. A comparison is made with the flow sound field distribution under a constant load. The study found that the number of vortices in the flow field under the random load is greater and more extensive, resulting in a more complex flow. The size of the source of loudness in the acoustic field and the degree of complexity of the field are directly proportional. It can be initially considered that the surface of the tower is the sound source.

articleTitle: Life Analysis and Maintenance Plan of Directional Crystallization Turbine Blades of Gas Turbine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The development of the maintenance plan for gas turbine blades needs to ensure the reliability of the blades during operation as well as the economy of the unit. Taking the high-pressure turbine blade of a certain heavy-duty gas turbine as an example, the paper first establishes a model of the transient relationship between overall parameters and the thermal boundary of the blade, and obtains the transient temperature field of the turbine blade during startup and operation. By combining the stress-strain constitutive equation and life equation of directionally solidified materials, the low-cycle fatigue life and creep life of the blade are obtained. The paper further compares the impact of different operating conditions of the unit, as well as the adoption of maintenance plans based on different equivalent operating hours, on the reliability of the blade stage and the overall economy of the unit. The life analysis and maintenance plan development methods provided in this paper can provide a theoretical basis for the design, operation, and maintenance of similar turbine blades.

articleTitle: OSLC Implementation for Authoritative Source of Truth Construction in Aircraft Design: A Comprehensive Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: This paper explores the application of Open Services for Lifecycle Collaboration (OSLC) technology to address data connection challenges within Authoritative Sources of Truth (ASoT) in aircraft design. Emphasizing the importance of data consistency, accuracy, and real-time updates, the study demonstrates OSLC's potential in integrating disparate design tools and platforms, thereby optimizing the design process, enhancing quality, and reducing project risks. OSLC facilitates seamless data sharing and updates among design, analysis, and project management tools, ensuring decisions are based on authoritative information. A case study illustrates the practical application of OSLC in developing system-level requirements for aircraft design, showing how it can significantly increase project efficiency and data accuracy. The paper discusses the advantages and limitations of OSLC, highlighting its role in improving interoperability across engineering projects. Future research directions focus on deeper integration with advanced technologies, securing sensitive data, and leveraging cloud and big data technologies. The study concludes that despite some challenges, OSLC presents a viable solution for enhancing data connectivity within ASoT, underscoring the need for comprehensive integration, strict data governance, and continuous improvement in data management practices.

articleTitle: Adaptive Beamforming for FDA Radar Based on Symmetrical Array
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The beamforming of conventional Frequency Diverse Array (FDA) radar has the problem of angle-distance coupling, which leads to its limited application in range-related target location and jamming suppression. To solve this problem, an adaptive beamforming method based on symmetrical array is proposed. On the basis of adjusting the conventional uniform linear array to symmetrical array, the beam characteristics of FDA radar adaptive beamforming under logarithmic frequency offset are studied, and the beamwidth, sidelobe condition and output SINR are compared with conventional FDA radar. According to the results of the simulation, we get that the FDA radar based on symmetrical array and logarithmic frequency offset has more concentrated beam energy and better anti-jamming performance.

articleTitle: Optimization of Production Scheduling for Turbocharger Manufacturing Reprocessing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In order to improve the production efficiency of W enterprise, the turbocharger casting post-processing production line of the enterprise is analyzed and improved, so as to reduce the production cost of the product and improve the economic efficiency of the enterprise. First of all, This paper collected the product and production line information of W enterprise through actual research, analyzed the existing problems of turbocharger casting post-processing production line, researched the turbocharger casting post-processing production scheduling problem, determined that the production line production scheduling problem is the replacement of the water flow workshop scheduling problem, and set up a mathematical model of workshop scheduling optimization for this problem. Finally, the optimization model is solved based on the artificial bee colony algorithm, the simulation results obtained are analyzed, and the adaptability of the artificial bee colony algorithm in solving this type of problem is summarized.

articleTitle: A 16 MHz 2-Phase Peak Current-Mode Three-Level Buck Converter with Fast Transient Response and Capacitor Balancing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a 16 MHz 2-phase three-level buck converter (2P3L) based on peak current mode control, which can maintain high conversion efficiency over a wide output voltage range. The voltage on the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">F</inf> is easily influenced by nonideal factors, which can deviate from the ideal value, leading to serious issues such as overvoltage and decrease in efficiency. In order to eliminate the problem of flying capacitor voltage deviating from the ideal value in multi-level circuits, this paper adopts a voltage self-balancing technology. The converter proposed in this paper is implemented in a 65nm process. The simulation results show that under the action of the flying capacitor voltage self-balancing module, the voltage across it can be maintained at V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf>/2, thereby preventing the problem of excessive voltage stress in a single power transistor and improving the conversion efficiency of the system. The circuit can achieve a peak efficiency of 94.67% with an input voltage range of 2.7-5.5V and the output voltage range of 0.5-1.5V. When the load switch between 0 and 8 A at a speed of 100 A/µs, the undershot/overshoot can less than 35 mV.

articleTitle: Research on Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring Based on Time-Frequency Integrated Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) is a low-cost, easily scalable technology for obtaining fine-grained electricity consumption information. By obtaining device-level load information, NILM provides strong support for advanced applications such as energy management, precise maintenance, and security early warning of the power grid, which has a broad development prospect in the field of smart power distribution and utilization. However, there is a limit to the number of load types in existing NILM studies, and when the number of load types increases, the load identification accuracy may not be able to meet the practical needs. First, a non-intrusive load monitoring experimental platform is built to collect the current signal of typical loads for analysis. A time-frequency domain feature analysis method is proposed to construct a feature set integrating multiple features in the time, frequency, and time-frequency domains to achieve effective differentiation of multiple common loads. Finally, the non-intrusive load identification algorithm based on bidirectional long and short-term memory neural network combined with multiple attention mechanism (Multi-BiLSTM) is proposed and constructed to identify 22 common loads. The results show that the load identification accuracy of the method proposed in this paper reaches 96.76<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, which can realize the accurate identification of multiple loads.

articleTitle: Performance Study of Anti-Deterioration Additives in Alkylbenzene-Insulated High-Voltage Cable Oils
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: To mitigate the degradation rate of alkylbenzene insulation oil in oil-filled high-voltage submarine cables, this study focuses on the antioxidant performance of phenolic compounds, amine antioxidants, and metal passivators. An L9 (3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>) orthogonal experiment was designed to simulate oil aging in the laboratory. The results indicated that the oxidation stability multiples of alkylbenzene insulation oil significantly surpassed 8, ranging between 15 and 56, after the addition of nine composite additives. The composite additives demonstrated a notable enhancement in the antioxidant performance of alkylbenzene oil. The optimum formulation was determined to be 0.2% T501 + 0.1% L06 + 0.01% Irgamet39.

articleTitle: Analysis and Control of the Deposition Forming Process of Functionally Gradient Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: To make the deposition process of functionally gradient material more stable and improve the material forming effect. Analyzed the interference factors encountered during the deposition molding process, determined the dynamic model of the extrusion force during the deposition molding process through experiments, completed the identification of the deposition molding system using the least squares method, and designed a minimum variance adaptive extrusion force controller. Experiments were conducted using two different colors of caco3, and the effectiveness of the controller was demonstrated through comparative experiments.

articleTitle: Calculation of Lightning Trip Rate and Risk Assessment of Lightning Damage of ±500kV Line Considering the Influence of Altitude
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: There are differences in the lightning impulse flashover of insulators and air gaps at different altitudes, which lead to different lightning withstand levels. Therefore, altitude is a significant factor affecting the lightning trip-out rate. Generally, the higher the altitude, the higher the lightning fault rate of the line. However, most of the current studies on line lightning disasters have not taken into account the influence of altitude, which often leads to significant differences between the research results and the actual situation. This paper calculates the lightning withstand level of a DC ±500kV line under two conditions: considering and not considering the influence of altitude, and then obtains the lightning trip-out rate and analyzes its risk level. When the altitude influence is not considered, the DC ±500kV line is entirely at a low risk level. After considering the altitude influence, two Level III risk poles and one Level IV risk pole are newly added. This indicates that when the altitude influence is not considered, the lightning trip-out rate tends to be underestimated, potentially overlooking some high-risk poles. Calculations show that the average lightning trip-out rate after considering the altitude influence is 3. 326 times higher than that without considering the altitude influence.

articleTitle: Cause Analysis of Excessive Closing Time of the Check Valve for Steam Turbine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: This paper introduces the structure and working principle of the check valve for steam turbine, and the composition of the closing time of the check valve. Some power plants are selected as the object of analysis, the data of closing time of corresponding valves are counted, and the reason of exceeding time of the valves is analyzed. The reasons for the excessive shutdown time include the control loop delay time and the mechanical delay time. So the optimization suggestions are put forward, including adding ETS and OPC hardwiring circuits, shortening the execution cycle of logic pages in the controller appropriately under the conditions of controller performance, strengthening the quality control of valve installation and maintenance, reforming or adjusting the cylinder spring, increasing the spring rebound which can shorten the delay time and closing time effectively, and have reference significance to treat the problem of the excessive closing time of the check valve for the steam turbine.

articleTitle: Open Circuit Voltage-state of Charge Testing for a Lithium Polymer Battery Cell
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Lithium polymer battery is a new type of Lithiumion battery with polymer electrolytes. Compared with traditional liquid electrolyte Lithium-ion batteries, Lithium polymer batteries often have better density, higher power capacity, and longer life cycle. This paper investigates a popular Lithium polymer battery made by Zeee. The open circuit voltage-state of charge test is done under various temperatures to identify the battery capacity, charging/discharging efficiency, and the relations between open circuit voltage and state of charge. The testing results identify excellent performance of this type of cell under very cold temperatures (-25°C). The derived battery models will provide convenient tools for further applications in the real world.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis of Marine Diesel Engine Based on DA-DBN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Ship diesel engine operating conditions are transient and variable, fault mode is complex, fault mechanism is not clear, it is very challenging to acquire fault data. Therefore, the fault data can be obtained through the ship diesel engine open fault simulation, to achieve the coherence of the fault diagnosis process and solve the deep-level feature extraction problem. Firstly, the fault data are normalized, and the Deep Belief Network (DBN) is selected as the fault diagnosis model. By comparing the performance of different optimization algorithms, the Dragonfly Algorithm (DA) is selected to adaptively optimize the initial parameters such as structural parameters of the DBN, momentum parameter, and the iteration count, and the validation results indicate that it can significantly enhance the convergence time of diagnostic model, diagnostic accuracy, and generalization ability.

articleTitle: Research on Methods for Identifying the Structural Health Status of Transmission Towers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: For the problems of difficult extraction and low accuracy of transmission tower state information, a transmission tower tilt state identification scheme based on VMD and LSTM neural network is proposed. The problem that the VMD parameters are difficult to determine is solved by the optimization algorithm, and it is proved that the IMF components of each order of its decomposition can effectively extract the modal information of the pole tower structure. In order to make the information characteristics more obvious, the singular value decomposition of IMF components is performed, and it is found that the singular values of each order component have more obvious differences in different states of the pole tower. Finally, LSTM neural network is introduced for feature classification to form a fault diagnosis model. The results show that the accuracy of this method is 93.33% for the identification of tower tilting state, and the comparison analysis with other methods shows that this solution has the advantages of higher efficiency, better stability and more accurate.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Control Strategy for Wind-Energy Storage Participating in Primary Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: To propose a new cooperative control strategy of wind-energy-storage collaboration system in primary frequency control, this paper models the wind-storage joint primary frequency control system. The control models of wind turbine and energy storage are also comprehensively constructed. Optimization objectives, including primary frequency control service revenue, cost, and performance, are also taken into account. The improved soft actor-critic algorithm is applied to solve the optimization objectives. Simulation experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Detection Area Generation in Distributed MIMO Radars with Phased Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Distributed multiple-input multiple-output radar systems, when operating in the focused-transmit focused-receive mode, achieve long-range detection within an overlapping area formed by concentrating narrow beams from all transmit and receive antennas. The effective part in this area, called detection area, has a performance-defined boundary, thus its boundary will vary with beam dwell time and location. This characteristic brings challenges for radar resource management. Equipping with phased array antennas offers the potential to overcome the limitation. By adjusting shape and beam dwell time of beams, this paper introduces a method to actively generate a detection area with specific boundary and performance constraints. This method aims to minimize the beam dwell time for ensuring target search efficiency. A strategy, evenly allocating power to transmit-receive channels of each cell under test within the detection area, is used to address the detection area generation problem. It separates the optimization process into two stages: the first stage obtains beamforming weights through successive convex approximation; the next stage determines beam dwell time by using a binary search algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method can generate identically shaped detection areas in a certain airspace.

articleTitle: Proximal Policy Optimization with an Activated Policy Clipping
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Proximal policy optimization (PPO), a ubiquitous on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm, still grapples with instability and inefficiency in policy optimization due to the non-strictly restricted likelihood-ratio during policy clipping. In this work, we propose an activated clipping strategy for solving this issue. The clipping strategy is restricted by a tanh activation function, featuring a smooth yet precipitous objective curve, enhancing the stability and efficiency of policy updates. Experiments on the Pistonball cooperative multi-agent game show that the new clipping strategy produces competitive and superior results compared with the standard PPO, PPO with rollback (PPO-RB), and PPO smoothed (PPOS) algorithms, especially its high efficiency and success probability in searching optimal policies.

articleTitle: Equivalent Analysis Method for Coupling Scattering of Low Scattering Ships in Sea Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In order to solve the difficulty problem of rapid simulation on the complex structure of low scattering ship targets in the sea environment with good simulation accuracy, the homogenized materials were proposed to keep equivalent characteristics with complex structural materials, thereby the complexity of simulation calculation models was reduced and the rapid simulation of low scattering targets in the sea environment was achieved. The process included making an absorbing coating equivalent to complex honeycomb structure backed by substrate metal, and a lossy thin film dielectric layer equivalent to the sea surface of large depth. The results showed that the average RCS deviation of the equivalent model between the coating and the honeycomb dielectric layer was less than 0.13dB through finite flat panel simulation, and the average RCS deviation between the equivalent lossy thin film dielectric layer and the sea surface was about 1.15dB, which had the potential for simulation on electrically large target models. Finally, by simplifying the low scattering model in the sea environment through equivalent structure, the RCS of the composite model was quickly calculated based on the bouncing ray method. Compared with the two equivalent cases, the average deviation of RCS values was only 1.33dB, which verified the feasibility of this equivalent method with high efficiency and strong adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on the Cutting Mechanism and Cutting Experiments of Ti6Al4V
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Due to the high strength, lightweight, and corrosion resistance, Ti6Al4V material is widely used in aerospace, automotive manufacturing, biomedical, and other fields. Therefore, this paper researches machining mechanisms and experimental studies on Ti6Al4V to address its difficult-to-machine characteristics. Initially, the paper conducts a theoretical analysis of metal cutting based on the two-dimensional orthogonal cutting principle for Ti6Al4V material. Subsequently, through orthogonal cutting experiments, the mechanisms of chip and burr formation in Ti6Al4V are studied. The influence of different tool edge radii, cutting depths, and cutting speeds on the shear angle and chip morphology of Ti6Al4V is analyzed. Finally, single-factor milling experiments analyze the influence of cutting parameters on cutting force and surface roughness of Ti6Al4V. This research provides theoretical and experimental guidance for the processing of Ti6Al4V.

articleTitle: Study on Abnormal Heat Release in H-Ni Gas-Solid System Triggered by Pressure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The hydrogen charging of nickel wire in HNi gas-solid system was investigated experimentally, and the relationship between hydrogen charging rate, pressure and excess heat was studied in the system under different pressure triggering reaction conditions in this paper. Hydrogen charging with nickel wire is achieved by intermittent hydrogen charging method with hydrogen charging current of 5 mA to 24 mA steps of 1 mA. The results show that nickel wire is the best hydrogen charging condition at ambient temperature of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${{25}^ \circ }\mathrm{C}$</tex>, current of 13 mA and hydrogen pressure of 0.4 MPa, the hydrogen charging rate is 4.72, and has good repeatability. In the pressure trigger experiment, the nickel wire obtains 3.39W thermal output power and the superheating energy is 10.456 kJ under the conditions of 0.5 A and 220 Pa. The samples were analyzed by SEM (scanning electron microscope) and EDS (energy dispersion spectrum), and it was found that the local melting state appeared on the surface of the sample after pressure triggering, new elements such as Si and Na appeared. The results suggested that the superheating appeared come from a nuclear transmutation.

articleTitle: Modular Design and Simulation Experiment Analysis of Vehicle Fog Identification System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: With the widening of the field of traffic safety research, it is necessary to develop the ability of vehicles to identify adverse weather conditions, avoid traffic accidents, and constantly improve the level of traffic safety. Based on the comprehensive analysis of the characteristics of fog-degraded images, a vehicle fog image identification system is designed in this paper. The reliability of the system is studied through simulation experiments, and the test results show that the identification rate of the system still needs to be improved under strong interference, clear day and misty weather, and the identification accuracy of the general foggy day is high. After further improvement, it can be applied in the vehicle auxiliary safe driving system, which helps drivers and vehicles better adapt to the changing traffic environment.

articleTitle: Preventive Test Analysis of Dry-Type Air-Core Smoothing Reactors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: This paper introduces preventive test of ±800kVdry-type smoothing reactor without dismantling the lead, which including measurement of winding resistance and measurement of inductance. The test result is compared with the one with conventional method and influence is analyzed. It was found out that the tests introduced above were practical and efficient. Meanwhile, the needing attention and suggestion for the tests is put forward.

articleTitle: The Master-Slave Game Pricing Strategy of Virtual Power Plant with Aggregable Resourcesand and Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: In view of the large-scale development of new energy, power grid regulation resources are increasingly scarce, peak load pressure is gradually increasing, and the absorption capacity of renewable energy is gradually insufficient. This paper proposes a master-slave game pricing strategy that considers the economic benefits of both virtual power plant (VPP) with aggregable resources and electric vehicle (EV) users. Firstly, the framework of operation transaction of virtual power plant with aggregable resources is established. Then, a master-slave game pricing strategy considering the economic benefits of both VPP and EV users is proposed. The model considers the impact of EV access technology on the whole system. Finally, with the given example, the analysis verifies that the strategy relieves the peak load of the power grid and improves the absorption capacity of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technology of Intelligent Road Detection and Maintenance Special Vehicle Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of road traffic safety standards, the impact of pavement damage on the safety and operational efficiency of vehicle travelling has received increasing attention from researchers. In this paper, a YOLOv8-based automatic pavement damage detection and damage condition assessment method is proposed to automatically detect the pavement damage condition using YOLOv8-seg. In addition, intelligent road maintenance solutions are discussed. The YOLOv8-seg model was chosen because it strikes a good balance between speed and accuracy for real-time pavement breakage pothole segmentation. Migration learning was implemented to tune the pre-trained YOLOv8-seg model for effective pothole detection and segmentation. In addition, lane line detection is accomplished using SCNN and MATLAB to improve the efficiency and accuracy of road maintenance and ensure the safe operation of vehicles. The method not only has the potential to improve the current situation of road maintenance, but also provides strong technical support for the sustainable development of automated driving technology in practical applications.

articleTitle: A Capacitively Coupled 3-Channel Digital Isolator with 160 kV/μs Common Mode Transient Immunity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: This paper presents a capacitively coupled 3-channel digital isolator with superior Common Mode Transient Immunity (CMTI). Transmitter (TX) employs the on-off keying (OOK) technique to enhance Common Mode Rejection (CMR). In addition, a common mode transient impulse suppression circuit is applied at the input of receiver (RX) to provide a fast release path for common mode interference current, further reducing the impact of common mode transient. Besides, the RX employs a pre-amplifier and an envelope-detection to demodulate signals. Post simulation shows that the proposed digital isolator achieves 100 Mbps maximum data rate, 10.1 ns propagation delay, 1.68 mA current per channel, 3 kV isolation breakdown voltage and 160 kV/μs CMTI.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wind Energy Amplification Effect of Highway Traffic Wind Generation by Wind Collecting Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: With the development of globalization and the change of the energy structure, wind power is of great significance. In order to achieve the goal of carbon peak in 2030 and carbon neutrality in 2060, industries are taking advantage of this opportunity to vigorously develop wind energy. In particular, transportation has high carbon emissions, and pressing demand for energy conservation and carbon reduction, therefore, it is imperative to improve the utilization and the efficiency of road wind energy. This research focuses on the design of a wind collecting device (WCD) that can amplify the wind speed on highways, the purpose is to improve the efficiency of wind power, and devote to the integration of transportation and energy industry, while assisting carbon reduction. The results indicate WCD can significantly increase the power output, and we also find the most efficient WCD through experiment.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Magnetic Flux Density in Rotational Electromagnetic Energy Harvester
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Rotational electromagnetic energy harvester is a kind of device with practical value that converts kinetic energy into electrical energy. This work investigated the effect of pure iron plate dimension on the magnetic flux density at spatial position of the coil in a rotational electromagnetic energy harvester. Increasing the magnetic flux density at spatial position of the coil in a rotational electromagnetic energy harvester is an effective means to enhance the output power of harvester, and the reasonable configuration of magnetic materials plays a crucial role during this process. In Finite Element Magnetic Methods (FEMM) software, models were established for different cases to obtain the average magnetic flux density in specific cross-sectional areas during the operating state of harvester. This work indicated that if a single coil in the harvester is separated into two series connected coils and they are closer to magnets, the magnetic flux density value will be increased to a certain extent. If a pure iron plate is set between two series connected coils, as width and height of the pure iron plate are appropriate, the magnetic flux density value can be increased by up to 8.5%, and correspondingly, the output power of the energy harvester can be increased by 15.2%. Therefore, it would be advantageous to configurate the rotational electromagnetic energy harvester with appropriately sized pure iron plates.

articleTitle: Distributed Finite-Time Event-Triggered Voltage Restoration and Current Sharing Control for DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: The significance of distributed control in DC microgrids (MGs) has surged in contemporary power systems. This paper introduces an innovative distributed finite-time event-triggered method to assure precise current sharing and bus voltage regulation, and through this strategy, communication burden can be reduced and the convergence speed of the finite time secondary control can be improved. Ultimately, the effectiveness of the introduced mechanism is demonstrated via simulations in various operating conditions.

articleTitle: A Method for Measuring Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy in High-voltage Battery Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy can be used to analyze the internal health status of batteries and estimate their lifetime. The traditional online method of measuring the electrochemical impedance spectrum of battery systems is difficult to apply in high-voltage battery systems and cannot be applied to high-frequency measurements. Therefore, this paper proposes a measurement method for electrochemical impedance spectroscopy. By connecting multiple half bridge modules in series and adopting a carrier phase shifting modulation strategy, the high-voltage battery system (800V) can be measured and the measurement frequency can reach up to 10kHz. The working principle and control strategy of the measuring circuit are analyzed and discussed in detail. Finally, simulation verified the correctness of the circuit topology and control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of UHV 1000kV Capacitor Voltage Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Energy and Electrical Engineering (EEE)
abstract: With the development of AC ultra high voltage (UHV) engineering construction, the requirements for key technical parameters of UHV capacitor voltage transformer (CVT) equipment are constantly increasing. Theoretical research has been conducted on the error characteristic, transient performance, voltage equalization technology, and seismic performance of UHV CVT. By analyzing the rated capacitance, frequency, temperature, secondary load, and stray capacitance parameters that affect the error performance of UHV CVT, an effective electromagnetic unit error adjustment technology is proposed. The UHV CVT meets the measurement requirements of 0.2 level and 15VA, improving the error performance of the UHV CVT.
